title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Family Monthly Cost Share Assessment
content:
## Clause

The Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) monthly cost share is a family charge: in any calendar month in which one or more family members registered in ECHO receive an ECHO benefit, the sponsor family pays one cost share (the most monthly cost shares one sponsor family pays in a calendar month), taken from the first ECHO claim of that month among all the family's registrations, at the monthly cost share of the tier in effect for that month. A second assessment for the same family month is reversed. A month with no ECHO benefit carries no cost share. A cost share is assessed only for a month in which some family member has a paid ECHO claim.

## Elements of the clause

| Element | What the clause fixes |
|---|---|
| Who pays | the sponsor family, not each beneficiary |
| Family | the ECHO registrations of the beneficiaries of one sponsor |
| Month | the calendar month of service |
| Number per family month | one; the count of cost shares for a family month is the number of cost shares assessed across all the family's registrations for that month and not reversed |
| Claim it is taken from | the first ECHO claim of that month among all the family's registrations; the cost share is recorded on that claim's registration and names that claim |
| Amount | the monthly cost share of the tier in effect for that month, as stated in the product's cost share schedule |
| A second assessment for the same family month | reversed |
| A month with no ECHO benefit | no cost share |

## Condition for assessing a cost share

A cost share is assessed only for a month in which some family member has a paid ECHO claim. The paid claim is established from the paid ECHO claim lines on record for a registration of the family in that month of service, as they stand before the cost share is assessed; a statement that services were received does not establish it.

## Hypothetical cases, for illustration only

*All inputs are hypothetical; "T" stands for the monthly cost share of the tier in effect for the month.*

1. **One child, one paid claim in May.** One cost share of T for May, taken from that claim.
2. **Two registered children, both with paid claims in May.** One cost share of T for the family for May, taken from whichever of the family's May ECHO claims is first; the other child's claims in May carry no cost share.
3. **Two cost shares assessed for the same family month.** The family month has one cost share; the second assessment is reversed, leaving one.
4. **No ECHO benefit for anyone in the family in June.** No cost share for June.
5. **Services received in July but no paid ECHO claim yet on record for July.** The condition for assessing a July cost share is not met.

## Basis Q&A

**Does each registered child generate a cost share?** No. The cost share is per sponsor family per calendar month, one at most.

**Which registration carries it?** The registration whose claim is the first ECHO claim of that month among all the family's registrations.
